hero.title: Public digital services, in code.
hero.lead: CODE is the developer platform of Astoria's administration: a common entry point to the projects, organisations, documentation, standards, APIs, SDKs and technical resources of the public sector.

ecosystem.title: An open ecosystem
ecosystem.lead: Code is a common interface for the public developer ecosystem, while remaining interoperable with existing development platforms.
ecosystem.text: A project referenced on Code can be hosted on GitHub, GitLab, Giteria or any compatible forge. Code does not replace these platforms: it references them and makes them visible in a single space dedicated to the public sector.
